title: Best Fixed Reporting Period
prerequisite: Comfort with array indexing and Lesson 2 cost analysis.
hints: Adjacent fixed-size windows differ by exactly two values: one leaves on the left and one enters on the right.
Compute the first window sum once, then update it by subtraction and addition instead of summing every window again.
Track the largest sum while sliding: subtract values[right - windowSize], add values[right], and update the best.
